WHY nC

Preserve meaning
across levels.

Layout, alignment, pointer validity and calling convention affect observable program behavior. nC aims to preserve those contracts across source, IR and emitted code.

Current work covers native reconstruction, runtime consistency and validation of objects and images on documented profiles.

BEFORE YOU RUN

Requirements and limits.

Dependencies, tested platforms and the scope of the V81 CLI.

Do I need Rust or LLVM?

The native kit includes the compiler and provider required for the first program. Building Stage0 from source still requires Rust, a verified native seed and an archiver.

Which systems have been tested?

The kit was tested on Windows x86-64 and Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL x86-64. Linux requires glibc 2.34 symbols or later. Other profiles have separate scopes documented in the technical references.

What does bootstrap mean here?

The project builds and verifies the compiler using its own tools. V81 records identical B/C generations within each host. Stage0 is retained, and global Stage3 promotion remains open.

Does type checking provide memory safety?

nC has manual/raw semantics. The program controls allocations, addresses and release. Type checking does not add ownership or implicit pointer-lifetime checks.

What belongs in a bug report?

Host and architecture, compiler and provider digests, complete command, minimal source, diagnostic and expected result. Identify whether the failure occurs during analysis, emission, linking or execution.

OPEN DEVELOPMENT

A reproducible regression.
A verifiable contract.

Include minimal source, the command, compiler digest, provider and expected result. A language change must keep parser, AST, semantics and IR consistent.
